question: Team TS3011 chose a combined energy source for their remote. What was the combination, and what happened to it when the costs were added up?
answer: Team TS3011 chose traditional batteries combined with solar cells, which Speaker C (Industrial Designer) said was more reliable and cheaper. When the production costs were added up in the evaluation meeting, the solar cells were the main reason the cost was far too high (22 EUR against a 12.50 EUR limit), so Speaker A (Project Manager) proposed skipping them, bringing the estimate to 12.40 EUR, which the team still judged too expensive.
